title: HB 2063 (107th General Assembly): As introduced, clarifies that persons age 65 or older are not required to show identification with a photograph in order to vote. - Amends TCA Title 2, Chapter 7.
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id)
(section) 2-7-112 (new subsection, unnumbered)
(quote) Notwithstanding any other provision of law to the contrary, any voter age sixty-five (65) or older shall not be required to show an identification with a photograph of the voter in order to be allowed to vote at the polling place.
(b_no_id_remedy) not stated.
(c_mail_ballot_id) not stated.
(d_proof_of_citizenship) not stated.
(e_other_rule) not stated.
(other) Section 2: effective on becoming law.
(other) version: 183332-Draft (2011-02-17): photo-ID exemption for voters 65 and older (slot a); Senate companion SB1828 in header.
(other) version: 524717-Draft (2011-12-11): identical body text; no change.
(other) note: Action log: deferred to a 'Voter ID Calendar' 2012-02-01, then 'Failed In s/c' 2012-03-14. LegiScan's motion line and the log disagree on the question put; the voice vote has no tally. Slot a only (exemption from photo ID, not from ID).
